column1: # The Linux system calls the stdlib and the compiler make that macOS's translation (stdlib/abla/runtime/platform/darwin/entry.ab,
# __ablaRuntimeDarwinSyscall) leaves untranslated, where it answers ENOSYS (-38), and why that call site is right to be.
# tools/test-darwin-syscall-coverage.sh fails on a call site of an untranslated number that no line here names (v0.2.62 to
# v0.2.68's frozen heap called mprotect 10 so, and every macOS program that froze a value died with SIGBUS), and on a line
# whose call site is gone or whose number is now translated.
